name: Black Hole Portal
description: Full-screen canvas of thousands of orbiting star trails around a central ENTER button. Hovering pulls the stars inward, clicking bursts them outward before they settle back.
contents: Full-screen canvas with orbiting star trails
Centered circular ENTER trigger with line accents
behavior: Stars orbit the center and leave fading trails
Hovering the trigger collapses the stars toward the center
Clicking expands the stars outward for a set time, then they drift back to their orbits
Trigger fades out while the expansion and recovery run
editableByProps: Button label, background and text colors, hover color
Star count, orbit size, expansion and recovery timing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the star trail color or fade strength
needsCodeEdit.where: this.color in the Star constructor and the rgba(25,25,25,0.2) fillStyle in renderLoop

needsCodeEdit.change: Run an action when the trigger is clicked

fixed: Root is full-bleed and fills the viewport height
Canvas is sized once on mount and does not resize with the window
Canvas redraws every frame, so it is CPU heavy at high star counts
Trigger is a fixed 255px circle centered in the section
